# name: # Hand-curated command signatures for math mode. `args` is a string of
# argument kinds in order: m = math argument (brace group or one token),
# t = text argument (brace group scanned in text mode: may hold $...$),
# o = optional [...] argument (opaque), d = one delimiter token (after \left).
# `flags`: style=<style> marks a math-alphabet command; plain marks a style
# command that resets to the default alphabet; star means a `*` right after
# the name belongs to it. Unknown commands take no arguments. A user
# definition read from the source overrides a row here.
# text arguments: scanned as text, never rewritten as math
